items.briefing:
Australia and New Zealand are experiencing a surge in critical security vulnerabilities, with organisations urged to review and patch systems promptly. Adding to this concern, a global threat campaign is actively exploiting a serious flaw in VMware vCenter — software used by many organisations to manage IT infrastructure. If your organisation uses VMware, contact your IT team today to confirm patches are applied. Meanwhile, AI-driven cybercrime is growing rapidly in scale and sophistication, and ransomware groups are at record numbers even as victim counts stabilise.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT support team whether VMware vCenter is used in your organisation and confirm it has been recently updated.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs leave Australian organisations vulnerable to 85 high-impact security flaws.
